home.name: IGNACIO FLEMING
home.description: Passionate about building innovative web solutions. With a strong background as a Product Owner, I bring a unique mix of technical expertise and business perspective. Whether it’s crafting smooth user experiences or solving complex backend problems, I focus on delivering real value through code.

whatsapp-clone.title: WhatsApp Web Clone
whatsapp-clone.description: A real-time messaging application inspired by WhatsApp Web. Built with React, Node.js, and WebSockets, it features user authentication, chat rooms, message history, and live communication. Designed with modular architecture and a focus on performance, it's a solid example of full stack development in action.

business-manager.title: Business Manager
business-manager.description: Web app for managing products, clients, and sales. Built with React and Node.js, connected to a MySQL database through a RESTful API. Designed to be scalable, modular, and intuitive for real-world business operations.

the-office-store.title: The Office Store
the-office-store.description: Full-featured e-commerce platform developed with React and Node.js. Includes secure Stripe payments, product browsing, cart management, and a full admin panel to manage users, orders, and inventory.

vizcacha-wines.title: Vizcacha Wines
vizcacha-wines.description: Institutional site for a local winery, developed with React and Material UI. Features a contact form integrated with Firebase Firestore and a Node.js service to handle email notifications.

serminca.title: Serminca
serminca.description: Professional website for a mining company, built with React and styled using Material UI. Includes Google Maps integration and a dynamic contact form backed by Firebase and Node.js for notifications.

todo-app.title: TODO App
todo-app.description: Lightweight task management app built with Vanilla TypeScript. Focused on clean code, modular structure, and a smooth user experience for daily task tracking.

paragraphs.p1: My journey into software development began in 2022, while working in the back-office operations of a stock brokerage firm. I started programming in VBA, automating most internal processes through custom macros.
paragraphs.p2: As I improved my technical skills, I moved into the Product team, leading key projects related to cash-in/out flows, account balances, and holdings. One of my proudest accomplishments was leading the launch of a cryptocurrency app from scratch.
paragraphs.p3: Alongside my professional growth, I completed a Full Stack bootcamp that deepened my interest in web development. I’ve since continued my learning through courses and hands-on practice, always striving to stay current with modern technologies.
paragraphs.p4: I’m eager to join a team where I can keep growing, contribute as a developer, and help build meaningful solutions through code.
